"I have observed much in ancient and modern times,
but there has never been a case where, after receiving the imperial testament and entrustment,
the successor ruler was murdered
and the virtuous princes were executed."
In the second year of Yuánjiā,
he presented a memorial congratulating the New Year
and also describing the drought disaster,
saying: "The New Year renews the calendrical system,
and all things are made new.
Your Majesty, relying on daily renewal to accumulate virtue,
looks up to the Primal Qian to assume the throne;
good fortune gathers in your household,
and a hundred blessings come to your court.
Recently, the drought demon has wreaked havoc,
the scorching sun exceeding its limits,
drying up flowing rivers,
and depleting wells, whether common or isolated.
The old and weak cannot bear to draw water from afar,
and the poor and widowed struggle alone to carry water.
As tribute payments are
heavy
and taxes are not reduced,
the common people complain and sigh.
I am over seventy years old
and have never seen such a drought.
If yin and yang are separated,
then harmonious qi will not interact;
not only will there be famine,
but diseases and epidemics will certainly arise.
The worries and anxieties caused by this
cannot be fully enumerated.
The rituals of yú and yíng [for rain and warding off calamities]
are performed with sincerity,
and though shamans and priests pray constantly,
they rarely elicit a response.
The chastisement from Heaven
must not be ignored.
In Hàn, in Dōnghǎi, a filial
woman was unjustly killed,
and a severe drought lasted three years.
When her tomb was sacrificed to,
heavy rain immediately fell,
and the year was bountiful.
Thus, when the people of Wèi attacked Xíng,
rain fell as soon as the army set forth.
I humbly pray that Your Majesty
will follow ancient wisdom,
strive to implement lofty principles,
extend the love of loyalty and forgiveness,
and show compassion for cases of injustice.
Let your heart dwell on the suffering of the common people,
and your thoughts be fixed on the records of the unseen world.
Let the remonstrance
post be erected at the palace gate
and the drum of admonition sound in the court.
Examine the words of the common folk
and grasp the essentials of governance.
If this is done,
then stability will be secured like tying a silk cord to a fragile branch,
and signs of danger will be absent.
If disaster
and harm do not then disappear,
it has never happened.
Therefore, Xià Yǔ took the sins of the hundred surnames upon himself,
and Yīn Tāng willingly accepted the faults of the myriad regions.
Tàiwù improved his virtue through the mulberry and grain omens,
and Sòng Jǐng relied on
the comet to cultivate goodness.
These all turned failure into success,
which is clearly demonstrated by past events.
Those who follow vulgar customs are hard to establish as models,
but those who follow the right path are easy to refine.
My
illness worsens daily;
I do not plan for tomorrow's court at night.
Coinciding with the New Year's celebration,
I am able to express my views once.
If my humble sincerity gains a little clarity,
I will have no regrets in the underworld.
I will forever depart from Your Majesty's presence,
and as I present this memorial, I choke with sorrow."
Thereupon, he traveled by light boat to Dōngyáng,
acting according to his own will,
without regard for the imperial court.
The officials charged and memorialized against him,

At that time, although Tàizǔ was personally governing,

Although my words are not worth adopting

My life has been dedicated to service,

I shared difficulties on the battlefield,

Unable to repay such great kindness,

I am old and infirm, exceeding my proper station,

Indeed, affairs are mostly cautioned against by excessive delay,

Entrusting officials to scholarly posts,

My humble self

The foolish opinions I previously presented

When the memorial was presented,

At that time, Sītú Wáng Hóng (王弘) was assisting in governance.

At that time, the drought had not ceased,

Tà (泰) again submitted a memorial, saying:
"Recently, the drought has lasted for a long time,

Compared to ordinary disasters,

I believe that Heaven's attention towards a virtuous ruler

Your Majesty should follow the example of Yǔ (禹) and Tāng (湯) in attributing the people's faults to yourself.
Let your words and actions stem from your heart,

If the mulberry and grain grow in court and then perish,

The spiritual rain will immediately fall,

Your Majesty should now look up to Heavenly will,

The reforms for peace and prosperity
still preserve old institutions.
It is simply a matter of whether you contemplate or not,

Although the great Sòng (宋) received the mandate through abdication,
it has not yet accumulated the virtue of Yǒu Yú (有虞).
The day the late emperor ascended to the heavens

Thereupon, the successor was murdered,
and the wise princes suffered misfortune.
The nine regions hesitated,

Ministers who aided the founding and were entrusted with the young heir

The world was in chaos,

If not for a divine hero

Revolution versus adapting to the times—
the meaning is especially profound.
This is why ancient and modern practices differ;
adhering rigidly to convention inevitably leads to stagnation.
The great Way is obscured by minor accomplishments;
desiring speed may not necessarily lead to arrival.
The technique of deep roots and solid foundations

which is why I madly and presumptuously act without being able to remain silent.
I am both stubborn and crude,
